entries.title: Diplomacy is Not an Option
entries.definitive_edition: Diplomacy is Not an Option 1.0 on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Diplomacy is Not an Option left Early Access on October 4, 2024 and is documented as a Windows PC strategy/city-defense release on Steam and GOG. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so Windows PC is both the complete route and the best archive capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC 1.0 release on Steam or GOG. Use the latest patch before capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with the full 1.0 campaign and current patch path.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform and best capture route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform or edition split was found.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster, definitive edition, or platform-exclusive content exists.
